body: Owner's decision of 2026-10-21 (~06:14 PDT), confirmed to the BewareILive session directly at 06:25 PDT. BewareILive's three open games by units produced: Defender (55,000+, Kent 2001), Joust (~26,000, uncited) and Robotron (~19,000, Kent 2001), worked in that order. Stargate ties with Joust on an uncited 26,000 and shares Defender's engine, so it follows Defender. Being recorded in AGENTS.md and docs/decisions.md with the full ranking and sources.
summary: Acknowledge the owner's loop change: three games open at once, ordered by units produced, shared systems built first rather than deferring a popular game
